# Wet DBA en zelfstandigen: wat verander: # Wet DBA and self-employed professionals: what is changing and what does it mean for you? ## Enforcement has already begun Since 1 January 2025, the Dutch Tax and Customs Administration has once again actively enforced the Wet DBA (Deregulation of Assessment of Employment Relationships Act)…
De Wet DBA wordt actief gehandhaafd. Lee: The Wet DBA is being actively enforced. Read what false self-employment means, what responsibilities clients and self-employed professionals have, and what the upcoming Self-Employment Act may change.
Sinds 1 januari 2025 handhaaft de Belast: Since 1 January 2025, the Dutch Tax and Customs Administration has once again actively enforced the Wet DBA (Deregulation of Assessment of Employment Relationships Act). This means clients and self-employed professionals now face a real risk of additional tax assessments and penalties if a working relationship is later classified as employment.
De vrijstelling van handhaving die jaren: The long-standing enforcement moratorium has ended. The question is no longer whether this matters, but how you deal with it as a self-employed professional or client.
